evidence_items.finding: annual amount retained after costs has declined for two consecutive years with no identified cause
evidence_items.rationale: Two-year decline in net surplus is a critical margin erosion signal. financial_health dimension; is_critical=true. No must_identify vocabulary used.

evidence_items.finding: purchase prices paid to suppliers have increased but the owner cannot quantify the change by product
evidence_items.rationale: Rising supplier prices without quantification is a financial health adverse signal. No must_identify vocabulary used.

evidence_items.finding: no price adjustments have been made to customers in over 18 months despite changing input costs
evidence_items.rationale: Customer pricing not adjusted while costs move is a margin erosion contributor. financial_health dimension. No must_identify terms used.

evidence_items.finding: owner is unable to identify which products or customers are contributing most and least to business returns
evidence_items.rationale: Absence of visibility into financial contribution by product is a critical diagnostic gap. financial_health dimension; is_critical=true. No must_identify terms used.

evidence_items.finding: annual revenue AUD 1.1M; 6 staff; three product categories all reported as a single combined figure; no breakout by category available
evidence_items.rationale: Combined reporting across three product categories without breakout is the structural gap preventing diagnosis. is_critical=true. No must_identify terms used.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): overall revenue has not declined and all major customers have been retained
evidence_items.rationale: Revenue stability and customer retention are misleading signals when margin is declining in unmonitored categories. Non-critical, LOW confidence.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): a new wholesale account was opened six months ago adding volume
evidence_items.rationale: New account volume is a misleading signal when the profitability of that volume is unknown. Non-critical, LOW confidence.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): owner believes cost pressure is a general market condition affecting all businesses equally
evidence_items.rationale: Attribution to general market conditions is a misleading signal that masks category-specific cost movements. Non-critical, LOW confidence.

metric_key_mappings.transform_note: Proxy: two-year surplus decline without identified cause in a stable-revenue business implies approximately -12% shift in effective margin percentage. Negative value signals margin erosion direction to the engine.

clarification_requests.would_improve_pattern: fin_isMarginErosion (confirmed margin change by product category would elevate confidence)

validation_notes: SIM-03-001 is a margin erosion case with deliberate data gaps — no product-level reporting exists. No must_identify vocabulary used (product-level profitability, supplier cost increases, pricing review gap, blended reporting masking individual performance, unrecovered cost increases — none appear in findings). Margin proxy negative to signal erosion.
